insights.title: Maya is today's main conversation partner
insights.text: Maya spoke 5 times across lecture, lunch, library and the hackathon, usually in front of you.

insights.title: Most name calls came from behind
insights.text: 3 of 5 name calls came from behind you (more than 150° off your front). The belt cue mattered most for these.

insights.title: The café and the hackathon were the loudest places
insights.text: Both had overlapping crowd speech for most of the visit; the crowd filter hid 30+ background lines while keeping your name and your order.

insights.title: A recurring unknown sound on your left in the library
insights.text: 7 low-confidence unknown sounds, all from about -90°, every ~15 min. Likely the air handler: HERE kept them as ambient with their direction.

insights.title: Lecture is where deadlines happen
insights.text: Both of today's deadlines were spoken in CS 341 from the front. Prof. Lee also moved office hours.
